conditions.blob_support: Resolve native body and pool admission separately for this profile/interval, including supported negative preactivation behavior.
conditions.authorization_support: Resolve SetCode authorization rules from the exact native profile/interval; preserve a proof for any inapplicable execution.
conditions.native_system_body: Resolve whether the native profile has a system action represented by an actual body transaction; outside-transaction optional data is separate.
conditions.optional_bor_legacy_enabled: Execute only for an explicitly enabled accepted optional Bor legacy receipt profile; otherwise retain the accepted disabled-extension evidence cell.
conditions.optional_outside_tx_enabled: Execute only when the accepted optional outside-transaction extension is enabled; never silently convert this to mandatory product scope.
conditions.historical_state_root_receipt: Resolve a historical receipt interval through a native seam when the current runtime has no state-root receipt.

specification.proof: Validate the specific artifact or expected refusal. A document check proves no native runtime outcome.
forbidden: runtime PASS inferred from valid documentation

inputs.description: original native block and transaction bytes
pre/post native state commitments and account/storage proofs
separately authored contract action ledger or independent reference execution

native-and-contract.proof: Freeze expected identities and values before execution from original native inputs and a reviewed independent ledger/reference implementation. Cross-check state roots, receipts, code, nonce, balances, storage, calls, rollback scopes, and fees. The extractor and its normalizer cannot write expected output.
forbidden: expected records generated by the normalizer under test
receipt/log count as a complete trace oracle
using one profile result for another

wire.proof: Compare bytes/digests and exact identity sets, prove the specific rejection for malformed inputs, and include positive controls. Keep synthetic evidence separate from native E2E.
forbidden: synthetic frame as native execution evidence

inputs.description: both durable owner logs and delivery manifests
raw NATS stream sequences and producer PubAck evidence

delivery.proof: Join exact source, logical, and physical identity sets with immutable bytes, verify terminal closure and the declared fault outcome, and prove forbidden output absent inside the closed boundary.

inputs.description: independent native admitted-block and lifecycle ledger
complete native body transaction inventory and original receipt/header bytes
D87 closed source and stream boundaries

public-inventory.proof: Build the complete expected logical identity set from native block/transaction/lifecycle decisions, including reorg revisions and empty blocks, without using normalized output. Assert the declared public fields: network/profile, source identities/order, original header/transaction/consensus receipt bytes, lifecycle references, framing and delivery. Record unasserted internal trace/state fields explicitly; smoke does not prove full trace semantics.
forbidden: receipt counts used as the expected identity set
unverified internal trace fields reported as semantic proof
rare public events assumed to occur

scenarios.stimulus: Prepare owned ERC-20/721/1155 contracts with explicit balances, approvals, receiver behavior, and integer-boundary inputs; execute each named action inside the run.
scenarios.expected: Check exact calls, bytes, logs, nonce, storage, balances, fees, and rollback against the contract recipe and independent native state. A Transfer log alone is insufficient.

scenarios.stimulus: Use tiny owned contracts or pinned hand-assembled bytecode to enter the named call path; include parent and sibling writes before and after the child.
scenarios.expected: Compare call input/output, entry order, gas, local and ancestor outcomes, cause links, and surviving/reverted effects against a separately authored execution ledger.

scenarios.stimulus: Execute a fresh CREATE/CREATE2 inside the measured run with controlled sender nonce, salt, initcode, and preexisting target state.
scenarios.expected: Compare attempted/known/committed addresses, code and nonce, constructor logs, local result, and ancestor rollback. Fork-inapplicable restrictions require a source rule, never an invented failure.

scenarios.stimulus: Execute small contracts or valid native envelopes that exercise one named state path with explicit prestate; compose child success with ancestor revert.
scenarios.expected: Compare all operations and final before/after state independently; preserve fees and authorizations that survive native rollback. Apply the exact interval's SELFDESTRUCT, transient-storage, and authorization rules.

scenarios.stimulus: Use exact gas limits/prices, refund-generating state, fee recipients, and native transaction types from the resolved interval.
scenarios.expected: Independently compute purchase, unused-gas return, recipient credits, and receipt fee; compare each actual effect once, including failed execution and zero-fee system rules.

scenarios.stimulus: Import prepared native blocks and run the named operation through the adapter, Gateway, and real NATS using small immutable fixtures.
scenarios.expected: Require full D87 closure and exact comparison. These cells do not close functional, fault, soak, or public-smoke cells.

scenarios.stimulus: Pause or fail the exact publication/stream boundary from D87 with real NATS at the pinned topology; preserve an exhaustive attempt census.
scenarios.expected: Check the declared positive or negative predicate, terminal-barrier conformance, sequence interval, immutable retries, and forbidden output. Seal ACK or quiet delay never proves closure.

scenarios.stimulus: Schedule both named events in one immutable plan at explicit native/protocol boundaries; preserve the source decision ledger and both stores.
scenarios.expected: Prove the original recovery/isolation guarantees and exact NATS output without combining evidence from retries.

scenarios.stimulus: Resolve each schema scalar width, blob chunk, typed fragment, record fragment count, manifest chunk, gRPC frame, NATS payload, and header budget to a concrete B; generate B-1/B/B+1 when representable.
scenarios.expected: Check exact valid encoding or the declared rejection. Zero uses zero/one plus a separate invalid-negative validator case; synthetic bytes do not prove native execution.

scenarios.stimulus: Stream a generated typed record/receipt over 2 GiB to bounded disk spool and through fragmentation; record the exact length and generator seed.
scenarios.expected: Verify native-codec-equivalent small golden vectors, streaming digest, complete reassembly, resource bounds, and retry bytes. This synthetic test does not assert a native chain can admit that receipt.

scenarios.stimulus: Observe new native blocks after readiness on the exact prepared public profile, then close the admitted window under D87.
scenarios.expected: Require nonempty new-block evidence, full closed-window delivery, exact header/receipt comparison, and correct profile identity. Do not wait for a random rare transaction type.

scenarios.stimulus: Use owned contracts deployed and funded in preparation; sign chain-bound testnet actions inside the run with a bounded funded signer.
scenarios.expected: Check exact inputs, fees, receipts, code, state, trace, and rollback against the fixture recipe; deployment before the run does not close CREATE. Missing funding/authority is NOT_RUN before READY. Deeper trace assertions require a separate reviewed ledger or independent replay from the actual block prestate and environment; otherwise the variant remains NOT_RUN before admission or FAIL after its deadline. Public smoke never closes the local trace matrix.

scenarios.stimulus: Resolve each requested topology to explicit profiles, stores, credentials, streams, dependencies, and a finite schedule.
scenarios.expected: Check no identity or state leakage; one profile's failure leaves independent profiles progressing, while a common NATS outage may block every delivery.

scenarios.stimulus: Prepare old/candidate locks with the named compatibility relation and pending obligations, or an explicitly malformed mismatch.
scenarios.expected: Preserve pending bytes and current binding, reject incompatible admission, and require fresh applicable evidence for the candidate. No automatic state migration is implied.

scenarios.stimulus: Generate a reproducible action sequence from seed index and plan digest with weighted valid transactions, caught/uncaught reverts, restarts, outages, and branch changes.
scenarios.expected: Require at least 256 actions per seed/current interval, invariant checks after each durable boundary, exact final output, and minimized saved counterexamples; never use the normalizer as oracle.

scenarios.stimulus: Run the declared duration and action floor while recording queue occupancy, durable pending bytes/batches, RSS, CPU, disk, and recovery progress.
scenarios.expected: Meet both duration and count floors, the actual backlog floor, bounded memory, immutable retries, and D87 final closure; early completion is not PASS.

scenarios.stimulus: Use the deterministic greedy covering rows produced by the definition; preserve every factor-value pair. Resolve invalid native preconditions with reviewed constraints before READY.
scenarios.expected: Check the combined sequence against source, lifecycle, durability, and delivery invariants; pairwise rows do not replace mandatory compound faults.

pairwise.rule: Every pair of factor values must occur in at least one prepared local-e2e row per profile/current interval. A source-infeasible pair needs an explicit reviewed constraint and remains visible. Mandatory compound scenarios are additional, not replaced by pairwise rows.

resolution.rule: Every expanded obligation is assigned before READY. Resolve exact fork predicates, native admission, fixture identity, oracle, compiler target, and expected outcome from pinned sources. Keep inactive/unsupported obligations visible with a reviewed source proof or NOT_RUN; unresolved mandatory obligations block acceptance.
resolution.intervals: Group equal activation values only within the same unit. Genesis has no valid minus-one block. Never sort block heights, timestamps, total difficulty, and epochs as one number. E01/E06 map each source activation group and each reachable native feature interval to exact native predicates and an immutable interval ID.
resolution.historical: Historical and future source branches require native-seam obligations. Only a current profile with proved native import equivalence and real supporting components may close current local-e2e. An unavailable historical full-consensus runner is not replaced by a claim of full E2E.
resolution.compiler: Pin compiler version/commit/binary digest, language, full settings, EVM target, source and linked-library digests, init/runtime bytecode digests, and reproduction command. Prove the generated opcodes and initcode rules are valid for the resolved interval. Use an older pinned compiler or reviewed hand bytecode when necessary; do not attribute an unsupported compiler opcode to the extractor.
resolution.public: Public mainnet is passive. Testnet signing requires exact chain identity, owned-contract deployment/code proof, funded accounts, nonce strategy, spending limit, and readiness. No public consensus or governance control is assumed.
resolution.expected: Preparation may construct expected fixtures and independent ledgers, never actual SUT results. Execute every scenario action inside the measured run. Freeze expected predicates before READY; public identities may be bound during the window from the independent native ledger, not from output being checked.
resolution.case_registry: Definition cells are not schema-v3 CaseRegistry entries. COMMON/document maps to the existing DOC profile with profile_manifest_digest and fork_variant NOT_APPLICABLE and fixture_kind document. Preserve ac_id, task_id and suite; derive variant_id from recipe, variant, mode and dimension. Runtime profile digests, fork variants and unresolved fixture kinds remain null in the projection until E01/E06 bind real artifacts. The definition mode names harness and synthetic are evidence classifications, not new fixture_kind enum values.

size_boundaries.nats_header_size: resolve exact bound stream name and immutable 123-byte Nats-Msg-Id headers
size_boundaries.typed_item_packing: resolve maximum prefix fitting actual fragment index and wrapper
size_boundaries.manifest_chunk_packing: resolve maximum entry prefix fitting actual control wrapper
